meta.title: A line with no status and no PR reference slips in as a plain catalog line
gaps: The available vocabulary does not expose a PR reference field, so the request cannot explicitly set or verify that it is absent.
The available vocabulary does not expose a read-back field path for confirming the line's product and quantity or the absence of a twin line.

words.preconditions: A buyer signed in to the client under test (no event is built).
steps: The buyer creates a draft event without the status.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the new event is a draft.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the new event is a draft.

plan.title: A line with no status and no PR reference slips in as a plain catalog line

assert.say: the new event is a draft
